payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.hiddenHint: You can’t see pay amounts: ask for the “See salaries” permission.
payroll.adjustmentKindHint.bonus: A one-off reward added to pay
payroll.adjustmentKindHint.fine: Taken off pay, within the deductions cap
payroll.adjustmentKindHint.allowance: Extra pay for the month: travel, meals, a second branch
payroll.adjustmentKindHint.deduction: Taken off pay: a shortage, a uniform, a phone bill
payroll.payTypeHint.monthly: A fixed amount a month, less the days missed
payroll.payTypeHint.daily: A rate for each day they come to work
payroll.payTypeHint.hourly: A rate for each hour checked in, overtime at its multiplier
payroll.payTypeHint.per_task: Only the rates of the tasks they finish
payroll.prorationHint.attendance: A day is the amount ÷ scheduled days; absences and unpaid leave come off
payroll.prorationHint.calendar: Only joining or leaving mid-month changes it, by calendar days
payroll.prorationHint.none: The whole amount for any month they work at all
payroll.totals.title: Totals
payroll.kpi.nextHint: {month} · {n} people, projected | {month} · {n} person, projected | {month} · {n} people, projected
payroll.kpi.nextHintRun: {month} · {n} people, finalized | {month} · {n} person, finalized | {month} · {n} people, finalized
payroll.runs.title: Payroll
payroll.runs.description: Everyone’s pay, month by month: prepare it, check it, finalize it and pay it.
payroll.runs.notPrepared: Not prepared yet: prepare it to see everyone’s pay for the month.
payroll.runs.emptyBody: Prepare a month: the pay of everyone with a pay setup is worked out from attendance, bonuses, fines and advances.
payroll.runs.emptyBodyView: When a month’s payroll is prepared, it appears here.
payroll.prepare.title: Prepare payroll
payroll.prepare.description: Choose the month. Everyone’s pay is worked out now; you can check it and recalculate before finalizing.
payroll.run.title: Payroll
payroll.run.warningsCount: {n} things to check | {n} thing to check | {n} things to check
payroll.run.finalizeBody: Pay setups, bonuses, fines and advances used here lock, and the salaries are booked in finance as owed. You can reopen it while nothing is paid.
payroll.run.finalizeWarnings: {n} warnings are still open. | {n} warning is still open. | {n} warnings are still open.
payroll.run.publishTitle: Send payslips to {n} people? | Send the payslip to {n} person? | Send payslips to {n} people?
payroll.run.publishBody: Each person gets their payslip in Telegram, with the PDF, and sees it in the app.
payroll.run.published: Payslips sent to {n} people | Payslip sent to {n} person | Payslips sent to {n} people
payroll.run.publishAgainHint: Everyone gets their payslip in Telegram once more
payroll.run.markPaidSome: Mark {n} paid | Mark {n} paid | Mark {n} paid
payroll.run.reopenHint: Unlock it to change and finalize again
payroll.run.reopenBody: Its finance entries are voided and everything it locked unlocks. Finalize it again when you are done.
payroll.run.cancelHint: Throw the draft away; the month can be prepared again
payroll.run.cancelBody: Nothing is booked yet. Bonuses, fines and advances stay as they are, and you can prepare the month again.
payroll.run.draftNote: A draft: check everyone’s pay, recalculate after changes, then finalize. Nobody sees it yet.
payroll.run.finalizedNote: Finalized and booked in finance. Send the payslips, then mark the pay as it goes out.
payroll.run.cancelledNote: This payroll was cancelled. It is kept for the history.
payroll.warnings.title: {n} things to check | {n} thing to check | {n} things to check
payroll.warnings.hint: Fix these before you finalize, then recalculate.
payroll.warnings.finalHint: Check these before the final payslip is finalized.
payroll.warnings.more: Show {n} more | Show {n} more | Show {n} more
payroll.payslips.extrasHint: Overtime, night and holiday work, leave pay, piecework, and the rounding of the amount paid
payroll.payslips.emptyBody: Only people with a pay setup get a payslip. Set their pay, then recalculate.
payroll.payslips.notCalculatedBody: Calculate to work out everyone’s pay for the month.
payroll.payslip.title: Payslip
payroll.payslip.addLineHint: A one-off amount on this payslip only, while the payroll is a draft.
payroll.payslip.lineLabelPlaceholder: Inventory shortage, taxi to the warehouse…
payroll.lines.none: No lines yet: calculate the payroll.
payroll.markPaid.title: Mark pay as paid
payroll.markPaid.description: Whose pay went out, how, and from which account. Finance books each payment.
payroll.markPaid.nothing: Everyone in this payroll is paid.
payroll.markPaid.everyone: Everyone waiting ({n}) | Everyone waiting ({n}) | Everyone waiting ({n})
payroll.markPaid.total: Total for {n} people | Total for {n} person | Total for {n} people
payroll.markPaid.confirm: Mark {n} paid | Mark {n} paid | Mark {n} paid
payroll.markPaid.done: Payments recorded for {n} people | Payment recorded for {n} person | Payments recorded for {n} people
payroll.payout.accountHint: The finance account the money left from
payroll.payout.noAccount: No account in {currency}. Add one in Finance › Accounts.
payroll.pay.description: What everyone is paid, since when, and what changes next. A change starts a new setup from a day you choose.
payroll.pay.missing: {n} without pay | {n} without pay | {n} without pay
payroll.pay.lockedReason: A finalized payroll used this setup, so it can’t change. A change is a new setup from a later day.
payroll.pay.emptyBody: People who join the team appear here; set their pay to include them in payroll.
payroll.pay.notFound: This person isn’t on the list
payroll.pay.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the person works in a branch you don’t see.
payroll.pay.readOnly: Only people who manage payroll change pay.
payroll.pay.noHistoryBody: Set their pay to include them in the next payroll.
payroll.pay.effectiveFromHint: Pay before this day stays as it was.
payroll.pay.planCreate: A new setup starts on {date}; the one before stays for the earlier days.
payroll.pay.planUpdate: This changes the setup that starts on {date}: no payroll has used it yet.
payroll.pay.planLocked: A finalized payroll used it. Pick a later day.
payroll.pay.perTaskNote: Paid only by the rates of the tasks they finish: set the rates on the routines and tasks.
payroll.pay.overtimeHint: Approved overtime is paid at the overtime multiplier from the settings.
payroll.pay.taskRatesHint: Tasks with a reward add it to the pay.
payroll.pay.nightNote: Night hours are paid with the night premium from the settings, for everyone who works them.
payroll.pay.errLocked: This day’s setup is locked: pick a later day
payroll.adjustments.description: Bonuses, fines, allowances and deductions: by hand or from the rules. Approved ones go into the month’s payroll.
payroll.adjustments.emptyBody.proposed: Proposals from managers and the rules land here for a decision.
payroll.adjustments.emptyBody.approved: Approved ones go into the payroll of their month.
payroll.adjustments.emptyBody.rejected: Rejected proposals are kept here for the history.
payroll.adjustments.emptyBody.disputed: When someone disputes a fine in the app, it shows here with their words.
payroll.adjustments.bulkApproveTitle: Approve {n} proposals? | Approve {n} proposal? | Approve {n} proposals?
payroll.adjustments.bulkApproveBody: They go into the payroll of their month, and each person is told in Telegram.
payroll.adjustments.bulkRejectTitle: Reject {n} proposals? | Reject {n} proposal? | Reject {n} proposals?
payroll.adjustments.bulkRejectBody: The same reason goes to all of them.
payroll.adjustments.bulkSkipped: {n} were already decided and were left as they are | {n} was already decided and was left as it is | {n} were already decided and were left as they are
payroll.adjustments.answerHint: They read it in the app and in Telegram.
payroll.adjustments.answerPlaceholder: The storage log shows 9 °C at 14:00; the fine stays.
payroll.adjustments.cancelTooHint: They were right: it comes off their payroll.
payroll.adjustments.voidBody: It leaves the month’s payroll; recalculate the payroll if it is a draft. The person is told.
payroll.propose.description: It goes into the payroll of the month you choose once approved.
payroll.propose.reasonHint: They see this reason in Telegram and in the app.
payroll.propose.reasonPlaceholder.bonus: Best sales in Chilonzor this month
payroll.propose.reasonPlaceholder.fine: Fridge log not filled in on 12 November
payroll.propose.reasonPlaceholder.allowa: Covering the night shifts at Yunusobod
payroll.propose.reasonPlaceholder.deduct: Shortage at the count on 3 November
payroll.propose.approveNowHint: Off: it waits on the Proposed tab for a decision.
payroll.propose.needsApproval: Someone who manages payroll approves it; the person is told once it is approved.
payroll.propose.errReason: Write the reason: they will see it
payroll.rules.description: Automatic bonuses and fines from tasks, attendance and sales. A rule proposes them (or approves them, if you say so); a preview shows who gets what before you switch it on.
payroll.rules.footnote: Rules check the data at the end of each day or month and never change a payroll that is already finalized.
payroll.rules.emptyBody: Make a rule like “20 000 so‘m for each late arrival after the 2nd” and see who it would touch before switching it on.
payroll.rules.name: Name
payroll.rules.minTasksHint: People with fewer tasks in the period are left out.
payroll.rules.evaluateHint.monthly: Once, on the month’s totals, when the payroll is prepared.
payroll.rules.evaluateHint.daily: Every day after closing, so people see it the next morning.
payroll.rules.modeHint.once: A fixed amount or a percent when the condition is met
payroll.rules.modeHint.per_unit: For each unit after the free ones: each late arrival after the 2nd
payroll.rules.modeHint.tiered: More for better results: each step has its own amount
payroll.rules.freeUnitsHint: Not counted: 2 means the first two late arrivals are forgiven.
payroll.rules.capHint: Never more than this in a month, whatever the count.
payroll.rules.positionsHint: Empty: everyone with a pay setup.
payroll.rules.autoApproveHint: Off: each result waits on the Proposed tab for someone to approve it.
payroll.rules.activeHint: Off: the rule is kept but proposes nothing.
payroll.rules.freeUnits: First {n} free | First {n} free | First {n} free
payroll.rules.previewSaveFirst: Save the rule to try it on any month: who it would give what, and the total. It can stay switched off until you are sure.
payroll.rules.previewSavedOnly: This is the saved rule. Save to see your changes here.
payroll.rules.previewNobody: Nobody would get anything for this month: {month}
payroll.rules.conditionTiers: The best step reached counts: the highest with “at least”, the lowest with “at most”.
payroll.rules.deleteBody: Bonuses and fines it already proposed stay as they are.
payroll.rules.errTiers: Each step needs its own value and an amount
payroll.metricHint.tasks.on_time_percent: Share of the period’s tasks finished on time.
payroll.metricHint.tasks.missed: Tasks never done by their deadline.
payroll.metricHint.tasks.reminders_per_t: Reminders a task needed, on average.
payroll.metricHint.tasks.avg_delay_minut: How late their late tasks were, on average, in minutes.
payroll.metricHint.attendance.late_arriv: Days they checked in after the shift start and grace time.
payroll.metricHint.attendance.late_minut: Minutes late, added up over the period.
payroll.metricHint.attendance.absences: Planned shifts they didn’t come to.
payroll.metricHint.attendance.early_leav: Days they left before the shift ended.
payroll.metricHint.sales.net: Their net sales as cashier in the period.
payroll.advances.description: Money paid ahead of payday and taken back from the payslips month by month.
payroll.advances.giveDescription: For someone who asked in person. It is approved as you save it; pay it out next.
payroll.advances.given: Advance approved: pay it out from the To pay tab
payroll.advances.installmentsHint: Equal parts come off that many payslips.
payroll.advances.capNote: Up to {n}% of their monthly pay (Settings › Payroll).
payroll.advances.paid: Advance paid out and booked in finance
payroll.advances.repaymentsNone: Nothing repaid yet. First month taken from pay: {month}.
payroll.advances.repaymentsLater: Repayments show here once it is paid out.
payroll.advances.cancelBody: It won’t be paid out or taken from payslips. The person is told.
payroll.advances.emptyBody.requests: People ask for an advance in the app or the bot; their requests land here.
payroll.advances.emptyBody.to_pay: Approved advances wait here until the money goes out.
payroll.advances.emptyBody.repaying: Paid advances are taken back from the payslips here.
payroll.advances.emptyBody.closed: Repaid, rejected and cancelled advances are kept here.
payroll.person.noPayBody: Without a pay setup they aren’t in the payroll.
payroll.person.noAdjustments: No bonuses or fines this month.
payroll.settings.title: Payroll
payroll.settings.payDayHint: When pay goes out, and how much people may ask in advance.
payroll.settings.payDayFieldHint: Day of the month. If it isn’t paid by that morning, people who pay are reminded.
payroll.settings.advanceDayHint: Day of the month for advances; empty for no fixed day.
payroll.settings.advanceCapHint: Share of the monthly pay one may ask in advance.
payroll.settings.deductionsHint: Limits on what fines may take, and how net pay is rounded.
payroll.settings.deductionsCapHint: Fines and deductions in one month take at most this share of the pay.
payroll.settings.roundingHint: Applied once, at the end of each payslip.
payroll.settings.extraPayHint: How much more an hour is worth at these times. The defaults follow the Labour Code.
payroll.settings.overtimeHint: Approved overtime hours, for people whose pay includes overtime.
payroll.settings.holidayHint: A shift on a company holiday.
payroll.settings.nightWindowHint: Hours of attendance inside this window get the night premium.
payroll.settings.dailyHoursHint: Gives the hourly rate of monthly and daily pay.
payroll.settings.nightNote: The Labour Code also shortens a night shift by one hour; that isn’t calculated here.
payroll.settings.taxesHint: Pay amounts here are what people receive.
payroll.settings.netHint: Pay setups are what people receive after tax.
payroll.settings.taxesOnHint: Adds income tax, social tax and INPS lines.
payroll.settings.taxesOffNote: Off by default: pay is paid as set. Turn it on only after your accountant confirms the rates.
payroll.settings.taxesOnNote: Check these rates with your accountant: they change, and the payslips use them as written.
payroll.settings.autoPrepare: Prepare last month’s payroll on the 1st
payroll.settings.autoPrepareHint: A draft, calculated, waits for you in the morning; people who finalize are told.
payroll.widget.title: Payroll this month
payroll.widget.empty: Set pay for your team to see this month’s payroll.
payroll.run.finalizeFinalBody: Their pay setup, bonuses, fines and advances lock and the pay is booked in finance. Whatever they still owe stays as a debt there. You can reopen it while nothing is paid.
payroll.run.finalizedFinalNote: Finalized and booked in finance. They no longer use the bot: download the payslip PDF for them, then mark it paid.
payroll.settlement.title: Final settlement
payroll.settlement.hint: Paid through the last working day, with unused leave paid out and every advance left taken back in full.
payroll.settlement.leaveDaysHint: HR counts them from the leave records. Each day pays the average day’s pay (Settings › Payroll).
payroll.settlement.saved: Unused leave saved: the payslip is worked out again
payroll.settlement.afterRegular: The payroll for {month} had paid their month already: this payslip pays the unused leave and what is still open.
payroll.settlement.owes: They owe {amount} after the settlement: it stays as a debt in Finance.
payroll.lines.leavePayoutHistory: At the average day’s pay of the last {months} months
payroll.lines.leavePayoutCurrent: At the monthly pay over the month’s days (less than a full month of pay history)
payroll.lines.advanceInFull: Everything left of the advance comes off the final payslip
payroll.settings.leavingHint: How the final payslip of someone who leaves pays their unused leave. Confirm the method with your accountant.
payroll.settings.leaveMonthsHint: The average day’s pay comes from the payslips of this many months before the leaving month.
payroll.settings.leaveUnitHint: Calendar days: the pay over the calendar days employed. Working days: over the working days paid.
